text:
sam_sales: Kicking off Skyline Health POC thread. They want a 3-week hands-on pilot: note summarization + semantic search. Need to align tech checklist, SLOs, pricing guardrails, and security asks.

eli_engineer: I can own the tech runbook. Couple quick asks: will summaries be consumed in a streaming UI or batched? Also, are they using our hosted vectors or self-hosted index?

maria_pm: For success criteria propose: 1) summary precision/faithfulness > baseline (we'll run blind evals), 2) p95 end-to-end latency < 800ms for interactive flows, 3) semantic search mAP >= 0.75 on pilot queries. We can tweak after first week.

josh_solutions: From Skyline: 5 clinicians, ~500 notes/day, peak ingest ~45/s. They asked about a pilot credit and whether streaming counts differently for billing. They also want SLA-ish behavior during clinic hours (8am-6pm PST).

anya_security: Security intake: they want SOC2 Type II docs, encryption details, and data residency confirmation. Important: they mentioned PHI. If PHI is in scope we need legal to sign BAA before data ingestion. Also: will they pseudonymize before upload?

sam_sales: They said they'll pseudonymize most fields but might send a small PHI subset for fidelity checks. I'll push them to keep PHI out if possible.

eli_engineer: Integration notes: hosted flow uses API key auth; we support streaming via SDKs. Node + Python quickstart examples included in the runbook. For retries: recommend exp backoff (base 200ms, factor 2, max 3 retries) and treat 429/5xx as retriable. Use X-Request-ID and respect Retry-After.

eli_engineer: Example (Node):

```
// node quickstart (hosted)
const Redwood = require('redwood');
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const stream = await client.generate({ model: 'rw-clinical-7b', streaming: true });
for await (const chunk of stream) { process.stdout.write(chunk.text); }
```

eli_engineer: Notes on vector/embeddings: if they use our hosted index we'll handle sharding and recommend an embed refresh cadence of daily for changing notes or on-write for finalized notes. If self-hosted, we'll provide the embedding API and schema.

josh_solutions: Pricing/quotas: suggest a pilot soft cap 120k tokens/day, alert at 80%. Offer $5k credit toward usage for the 3-week POC. Need to confirm with finance. Also propose concurrency cap of 20 concurrent streams to avoid queuing.

finance_bot: FYI finance approved up to $5k pilot credit for reps w/ customer approval. Any larger commit needs RevOps sign-off.

anya_security: For the questionnaire pack we'll provide: SOC2 report, DPA template, encryption (TLS1.2+, KMS details), pseudonymization checklist, and recommended logging redaction patterns. If PHI remains, legal must sign BAA prior to any customer data landing in hosted infra. For Private/Dedicated we can support CMK (customer-managed keys).

eli_engineer: Operational plan:
- Week 0: prep (access, keys, index strategy, eval prompts)
- Week 1: ingest pseudonymized dataset, run baseline evals, tune prompts
- Week 2: live clinician run, observe metrics, iterate
- Week 3: final eval and handoff + usage report

eli_engineer: Also: temporary Dedicated routing is available if we see overload; provisioning ~48hrs and requires a 2-week min commit. infra-bot can help provision if we decide.

infra-bot: ACTION: to provision Dedicated pool, open eng-infra ticket with estimated qps and duration. Lead time ~48 hours.

maria_pm: I'll assemble an eval harness (blind prompt set + scoring) so Skyline can validate quality independently. We should also agree on what constitutes a pass for them (clinician sign-off on N of samples).

josh_solutions: I'll confirm the clinician list, working hours, and expected query shapes (search vs summarize). Will push them to keep PHI out and use pseudonymized payloads where possible.

sam_sales: Great. Owners: eli = tech runbook (include Node+Py snippets, retry policy, streaming caps) by EOD tomorrow; anya = security pack + BAA checklist by Friday; josh = confirm users & dataset by Thu; mari(a)_pm = eval harness draft by Friday. I'll confirm the $5k credit with the customer and get them to sign the DPA.

maria_pm: Scheduling: suggest daily 15-min stand for the first 5 days and weekly after. Sam please set calendar invites.

sam_sales: Will do. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
